revenueStreams.name: Modeled public tax receipts
revenueStreams.description: GDP × player-set tax take (% of GDP); not an observed national tax receipt.

revenueStreams.name: Recorded resource and commodity receipts
revenueStreams.description: Uses the Resource Economy fiscal ledger when the active runtime provides it.

revenueStreams.name: Other recorded government revenue
revenueStreams.description: Uses existing finance revenue and tax fields only where the game state exposes them.

revenueStreams.name: Trade duties and customs
revenueStreams.description: Unavailable unless trade or finance runtime publishes a dedicated receipt value.

revenueStreams.name: State-owned enterprise dividends
revenueStreams.description: Unavailable unless the economy or finance runtime publishes a dedicated receipt value.

revenueStreams.name: Licences, fees and service charges
revenueStreams.description: Unavailable unless the economy or finance runtime publishes a dedicated receipt value.

revenueStreams.name: Grants and external transfers
revenueStreams.description: Unavailable unless the game records a country-specific transfer.

methodology.budgetShares: Initial allocation percentages are game-rule defaults and sum to 100%. Players may change them, but total planned allocations cannot exceed 100% of the annual expenditure plan.
methodology.economicOutput: Economic-sector output is estimated as current in-game GDP multiplied by the configurable default sector mix. This is a gameplay estimate, not country-specific observed sector accounts.
methodology.taxReceipts: Projected sector receipts split modeled annual public tax revenue according to configurable receipt shares. They are projections, not actual sector tax records.
methodology.runtimeReceipts: Recorded revenue from the finance/resource/trade state is displayed separately and is never relabelled as a modeled industry estimate.
